item.text: {"action":"experiment","hypothesis":"L015 showed that a cluster1 extra_trees/raw expert worsened pooled MAE and produced extreme errors on both reported-zero and high-Tc cases. Any route or subgroup improvement without both conditions is only a development tradeoff.","reason":"The required minimum remains pending at 15 of 22 successful unique cycles.
